【原视频简介】
Hi everyone! In this video, I put Claude Fable 5.1 and ChatGPT Astra head to head on 11 of the same prompts!

Every test runs twice - Fable's attempt first, then Astra's, back to back - so you can see both takes on the same idea before we move on to the next one.

Thanks for watching! I love you :)
